notes.title: Update released, DLC Cybermagic and Escape from Meridian are now available
notes.notes:
The waiting is finally over. Huge game update is now released and both DLC are now available.

Free update contains numerous new improvements and fixes, new weapons, armors, implants, new unique upgrades for weapons and your equipment, allowing you to customize your character and arsenal even more than before.



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29060021/1d3206b35723d18b4be03b62122b5dff74a1e00e.png
This DLC unlocks a fourth playable character, Xandria aka Cyberwitch, who specializes in active ability uses. It also adds a lot of new combat abilities that can be used by other characters too, and new unique ability for each of the characters. You can also equip experimental psionic accelerator as a secondary weapon that can interface with your abilities and vastly improve their efficiency. Psi-acc can hold two additional abilities, meaning that you can enter the mission with two combat abilities activated in your Psi-acc and two additional of your choice for support. Burn your enemies with plasma fists or throw fireballs around, summon chain lighning or crush their heads from distance. Depending on your character, you will be able to squeeze heart of your enemy so hard he'll explode, cover the way to your hideout with energy mines, suck energy from nearby enemies to support your offensive abilities, or even summon a melee weapon from pure energy.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29060021/815ce0a65074cc8f2090105dec73615af6811b4c.png
This DLC is a story expansion that adds a new story arc with 10 story missions filled with new enemies, new features and some surprises. New enemies of common type, various new boss enemies requiring special tactics, and even some special skills for those you've been hunting before. DLC also adds new levels for other game modes, a new challenging game mode against special enemies, new difficulty level Insanity for those of you who feel that even Hell is too easy, unlockable special setting "INFECTION" for increased difficulty and extra challenge that can be toggled on older missions, and some other small goodies like two new available unique weapons and an unlockable ability to summon an auto-turret to the missions to help you with all those new zombies or just for slaughtering them where you prefer to hunt for loot.

notes.title: Dead Effect 2 VR Update Beta available
notes.notes:
We're finally getting close for a final release of the update and two DLCs we've been working on for so long. Although we've been testing and bug-hunting relentlessly, it's possible that there are still some issues remaining and we'd be grateful if few of you would like to try the update before it goes officially out. 

If you want to access the beta, open properties for Dead Effect 2 VR in your Steam library, open BETA´S tab and in the combo box select Public Beta - "testing external". 

This will update your version to our latest beta. All your saves from the previous version will be automatically backed-up (to files profile0.sav.updatebackup) in case you would want to revert to the standard version before we'll update it. You might want to back up your data manually before you switch to beta. Then, you can find save files in AppData/LocalLow/Badfly Interactive/Dead Effect 2 VR/ folder on your computer.

Apart from the numerous old bug fixes and some small improvements, the update contains a lot of new content and some handy new features:

- New armor and implant sets and new upgrade modules for them with various unique boosts and bonuses, allowing you to customize your character even more.
- New weapon upgrades - you can now improve or modify your weapons with laser sights, penetrating ammo, scatter ammo and various new special boosts.
- New weapons, each in several variants. There are several small knives, 3 new big melee weapons, 3 secondary firearms including a small submachine gun, a new shotgun, and a new heavy rifle, all waiting to be added to your arsenal.
- A big pile of various unique weapons that can be unlocked by advancing in weapon training and finishing side tasks, bringing a total number of unique weapons to 25. New grenades, combo-weapons like a sniper-modified machine gun, shotgun revolver, powered melee weapon, shotgun modified to a powerful slug thrower...
- Several new side tasks
- Few improvements in the store screens (you can now mark weapons as favorite and filter available weapons based on their type)
- Sniper rifles now have night vision optics with a zoom that can be toggled in the weapon settings.
- Few small QOL improvements for VR that got requested before.

The update also contains necessary data for both upcoming DLCs. These are not yet available, but you can have a glimpse of some of the new stuff that will be available with DLCs.


Info about upcoming DLCs:

CyberMagic DLC unlocks a fourth playable character, Xandria aka Cyberwitch, who specializes in active ability uses. It also adds a lot of new combat abilities that can be used by other characters too, and new unique ability for each of the characters. You can also equip experimental psionic accelerator as a secondary weapon that can interface with your abilities and improve their efficiency. Psi-acc can hold two additional abilities, meaning that you can enter the mission with two combat abilities activated in your Psi-acc and two additional of your choice for support.

Escape from Meridian DLC is a story expansion adding a new story arc with 10 story missions filled with new enemies, new features and some surprises. It also adds new levels for other game modes, a new game mode, special setting for increased difficulty, and some other small goodies like an unlockable ability to summon an auto-turret to the missions to help you with those new zombies.

notes.title: Dead Effect 2 VR Update Info
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11613787/553e306da8f9728122beb17b2ed96b2a1ccde856.jpg

After a long time in development, we are getting to the testing phase of all the new stuff that we're preparing for Dead Effect 2 and we thought it was high time to give you some info about what you can expect. There's a ton of small, not so small and big improvements, changes and new content waiting for you! 
A lot of those will be contained directly in the standard update, but some will require you to buy a DLC.

 The arsenal  
There are new implants and armor sets and pieces, often with unique powers, which you can further upgrade or customize with new special modules. You can look forward to a pile of new weapons, both melee, and firearms. New revolvers, pistols, submachine guns, knives, rifles… 
There are also some new unique 'ultimate' weapons waiting for you, but you'll have to earn those and it won't be easy.
There are new upgrades for most of the weapons that allow you to further customize your weapons. How about a shotgun modified to fire strong penetrating slugs? Or would you prefer a rate of fire over accuracy with rifles modified to quick burst fire? Is your character specialized in weapons and your suit energy is usually full? Most melee weapons can be now upgraded to use your power for additional damage and chance to stun your enemies! A hammer with a kinetic capacitor that charges with each swing until it releases all stored energy in one strong kinetic burst is a very nice tool to quickly disperse crowds of those annoying zombies!
And there are also several utility upgrades you can mount on some weapon,for example motion scanners and laser sights. 

 Cybermagic  
Meet Xandria, call sign Cyberwitch, our fourth playable character. She's no noob when it comes to standard weapons, but she specializes in combat implant use in the battle and brings a lot of new abilities, mostly direct damage dealing, to the table.  Equip her with a psionic accelerator that boosts ability efficiency and watch the world around you burn. 
Would you rather stick with your previous character? All original characters will be able to use most of the new abilities and combat tools, but Xandria is the most efficient with them. She's The Cyberwitch after all.

 Story Expansion - Escape from Meridian  
The fight for control over the ESS Meridian was a stalemate for a while. But now the balance of power is quickly shifting in a way that looks grimmer and grimmer every day…
You can look forward to a lot of story missions (about half in size when compared to the original game), full of new enemies… and these are not your standard variety of dumb space zombies. Whoever controls these new hordes is also teaching new nasty tricks to the standard enemies – but as the elite cyber soldiers you'll adapt and overcome these new threats.
Playing through the story expansion will also unlock some new options, including new special difficulty level “Infected” that will challenge you even when playing through the original missions. And you'll get access to new locations for standard game modes that may contain some interesting loot!

Cheers!

Your BFI Team

notes.title: DE2VR BETA UPDATE 1.1.1 (QUICK FIX)
notes.notes:
We apologize, but one small annoying bug crept into the latest version that could cause problems in progressing in the first mission. It's patched now.
And as a small bonus, you can now customize holsters for the weapons.

ADDED:
 - Holster customization - you can now move and resize the active zones for your weapons and equipment in the main menu, in VR advanced settings

FIXED:
 - Script problems in the first mission that might have blocked the progress to the end
 - Plasma weapons continuing to fire after holstering
 - Fixed shotgun pumping jam
 - Fixed dual wielding weapon of the same type in multiplayer

Enjoy the game
Dev team

notes.title: DE2VR BETA UPDATE 1.1 WITH “HOT FIXES” IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Dear community,

We are pleased that the latest update in BETA has been performing very well so far. Thank you for all your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions. The update has been moved to the standard branch with some additional fixes.

Each day we are getting closer to the official full release DE2VR, thanks to your reporting as well.

What we have fixed:
 - Devious Deviant Holo sights
 - Deviant rifles reload
 - Boosting pistol damage, fixed holo sight
 - Venom shotgun sounds
 - Venom manual reload (ammo position)
 - Venom ammunition
 - Fixed wrong on hand hints for Oculus
 - Fixed wrong visual hint for ammo grabbing
 - Fixed grip on magazines for Synergy
 - Improved laser pointer for Oculus
 - Fixed bloom settings
 - Fixed bow drawing
 - Fixed wrong lightning in Base Defense mission

As always, if you have any comments, questions, suggestions or reports, please let us know in the forums. We will continue to work on testing and fixing, so any new comments will be much appreciated!

Enjoy the game!

BadFly Interactive team

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.1 - VOICECHAT is live!
notes.notes:
Here's a quick patch for you that adds a very handy feature - integrated voice chat for the multiplayer, so now can chat with random strangers or curse them when they're faster than you are in the deathmatch.

Voicechat session remains during the map change and in the hub, there might be short disconnection when the server or client loads the mission, but it should kick back quickly

Voice chat control is in the VR menu in multiplayer tab, you can mute someone or disable your mic.

We've also added other audio options so you can now control the volume of the sounds with greater precission.

BadFly dev team

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 1.2 IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
http://deadeffect.com/!de/presentation/DE2VR_PVP&Coop_steam.jpg 

Ready to experience MULTIPLAYER in Dead Effect 2 VR officially? 

Although there are still some minor issues going on, after weekend “beta testing” and reducing the list of bugs we would like to show up with the best we have got in Dead Effect 2 VR.

Its getting hot guys so we better challenge you with the coolest stuff ever. 
Update 1.2. is all about fixes, improvements and new features. Now you can play with or against your pals. You can either hunt them down in PVP modes! 
And there´s some new stuff for lonely wolves among you – namely 5 new story missions, some new maps and level cap increased to 15 which gives you access to epic equipment!

Please note that PvP mode is still in an experimental stage and we will continue improving it with the rest of the game. We DO need your feedbacks so there is no time to play shy on us. Tell us directly what you like and what you don't :)

Full change log: 
• Added: COOP multiplayer. You must finish first two missions, once you'll have access to the ship map, you can start or join cooperative games. 
• Story and generic missions cannot be joined in progress. Other mission types can be joined by others even in single player if your set allow joining in the game options.
• Added: PVP multiplayer. Accessible from the play menu, deathmatch and team deathmatch are available on several maps.
• Added 5 new story missions and few new maps for generic modes
• Increased level cap to 15 (giving you access to first epic armor sets)
• Increased revolver damage
• Added quick sell and upgrade quick buy - hold grip and click on item
• Added VR calibration - you can now modify world scale and floor position. Note: Setting correct scale is important for the multiplayer.
• Changed teleport blackout to use screen blackout instead Steam VR compositor (caused problems on some computers)
• Tuned melee swing detection - weapons now has to be swung with more force to do some damage. Rebalanced melee weapons a bit.
• Tuned knockdown effects.
• Fixed panel positions in Haxxor type side missions
• Fixed damage and haptic feedback for mounted gun
• Various small improvements in the GUI for the map and shops
• Fixed not working ammo boxes
• Fixed weapons not being returned after cutscene
• Fixed money loot falling through the floor
• Fixed mission summary screen bugs
• Improved response on several GUI controllers (consumables shop, side quest log)
• Fixed empty clips not disappearing
• Fixed Proteus STD weapon not working correctly
• Fixed trading stations GUI
• Fixed and tuned grips for several weapons

Changes and fixed from beta 1.2
• Added waypoints and marker to weapon in the mission Teleported Cyborg
• PVP stats rebalance
• Fixed codes not being shown in tablet messages
• Various small fixes in multiplayer and PVP

Dev team
BedFly

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 1.2 IS ON BETA NOW!
notes.notes:
http://deadeffect.com/!de/presentation/DE2VR_PVP&Coop_steam.jpg 

Are you brave enough to help us “betatest” the latest update for the Dead Effect 2 VR? 

Although there are still some minor issues going on, we have decided to give you a chance to take a look at some new stuff and especially at the multiplayer. 

Yes, you can now play the campaign with your friends… or kill them in any imaginable way in the PvP multiplayer.

And there are also some new story levels, increased level cap, bugfixes, minor improvements…

If you want to wait, all this (plus other bugfixes and improvements) should be available next weekend in a regular update.

If you can't wait – just join the beta right now! To join the beta – select DE2 VR in Steam, right click to open properties and select Beta tabs. You should see a public beta there. 

Please note that PvP is in very experimental stage and it will need a lot a balancing and improvements, but we've decided to give you access to it anyway. (And yes… we need more people to play it with us, we don't have enough headsets for 8 players anyway)

We are desperate to hear your screams, cries of bliss, even the cursing it´s fine… (since it's beta, we're sure to hear some) 

We will be grateful for any bug reports and impressions. Let us know, we are listening…

(Notice: there's no voice chat right now, but it will be added soon.)

Full changes list:
• Added: COOP multiplayer for 2 or 3 players. You must finish first two missions, once you'll have access to the ship map, you can start or join cooperative games. 
• Story and generic missions cannot be joined in progress. Other mission types can be joined by others even in single player if you set allow join in the game options.
• Added: PVP multiplayer (very experimental, but playable) for up to 8 players. Accessible from the play menu, deathmatch and team deathmatch are available on several maps.
• Added 5 new story missions and few new maps for generic modes
• Increased level cap to 15 (giving you access to first epic armor sets)
• Added quick sell and upgrade quick buy - hold grip and click on item
• Added VR calibration - you can now modify world scale and floor position. Note: Setting correct scale is important for the multiplayer.
• Tuned melee swing detection - weapons now has to be swung with more force to do some damage. Rebalanced melee weapons a bit.
• Tuned knockdown effects.
• Fixed panel positions in Haxxor type side missions
• Fixed damage and haptic feedback for mounted gun
• Various small improvements in the GUI for the map and shops
• Fixed not working ammo boxes
• Fixed weapons not being returned after cutscene
• Fixed money loot falling through the floor
• Fixed mission summary screen bugs
• Improved response on several GUI controls (consumables shop, side quest log)
• Fixed empty clips not disappearing
• Fixed Proteus STD weapon not working correctly
• Fixed trading stations GUI
• Fixed and tuned grips for several weapons

Enjoy the game
BadFly team

notes.title: EA (BUGFIX) UPDATE 1.1.1 IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Dear Community,
we'd like to thank you for your interest and enthusiasm for our game, for your suggestions and bug reports. We've decided to address some of the most troubling issues in a patch that solves or at least reduces the problems you might have encountered during the play. There's still a lot to do and polish, but we hope this patch will help you with waiting for our next big update.

• Added teleport blackout option (screen will turn black during the teleport jump to reduce nausea)
• Added haptic feedback in world gui interaction
• Improved placement of items in the levels for manual picking.
• Improved targeting for abilities
• Increased haptic feedback for interactive items and weapon holsters
• Fixed wrong sights on the TURN carbine (dot wasn't projected in the right eye)
• Fixed script problem in the first mission (blocked elevator leading to the end of the mission)
• Fixed sprint activation in click to sprint setting
• Fixed wrong help texts in minigames
• Fixed reload hint shown constantly on the shotgun with manual reload
• Fixed locker handle on open locker being still active and stealing player's hands
• Fixed possible crash or hangout on load when player has shurikens and knife or Knuckles equipped at the same time.
• Fixed ejected ammo that can't be picked in auto pickup mode
• Fixed problem with melee weapon sometimes not doing hits after switch of weapons
• Fixed ammo reload problems with dual wielding pistols for same ammo
• Fixed haptic feedback on weapons held by both hands and on melee weapons
• Fixed several problems with holsters (mostly shuriken related)
• Removed unused or non-working settings from the options

Enjoy the game
Team BadFly

notes.title: EA UPDATE 1.1 IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Dear community,

We are very excited about your interests in our Dead Effect 2 VR game, and we appreciate your support and positive feedbacks which were almost unexpected - it means a lot to us. 

Our next goal is to try to meet most of your game improvements and requirements that we want to tune and improve together with you. That's why we've decided to release the first EA update Nr. 1.1 with new content in the form of 4 story missions, new weapons to extend your entertainment in the virtual world. 

Enjoy the game and stay tuned! 

Your BadFly Team
